# The tail is the product

`customer_support.mm.queue_management.the_tail_is_the_product` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> The average customer experience is not experienced by anyone; the tail is.

Nobody escalates because of the mean. Reputation, churn and executive attention are generated entirely by the worst experiences, which is why a queue managed to its average can be simultaneously healthy and reputationally on fire.
